description: This file defines the 'InterestsScreen' composable functions, which are part of an Android app's feature module for displaying and managing user interests. It includes UI state management, previews, and interaction handlers for topics that users can follow or select.

classes.name: InterestsUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the UI state of the Interests screen, including Loading, Interests (with topic list), and Empty states.

methods.name: InterestsScreen
methods.description: Main composable displaying the interests list, handling different UI states and user interactions.

methods.name: InterestsScreen (internal)
methods.description: Internal composable managing the UI layout based on current state.

methods.name: InterestsEmptyScreen
methods.description: Displays a message when there are no interests to show.

methods.name: InterestsScreenPopulated
methods.description: Previews the interests screen with sample topics.

methods.name: InterestsScreenLoading
methods.description: Previews the loading state of interests screen.

methods.name: InterestsScreenEmpty
methods.description: Previews the empty state of interests screen.
